searchText: A little late, but finally here: I update ZRNT and ZCLI to v0.10.1, passing all test vecs, and using Herumi BLS. Should be quite useful Thanks <@203220829473996800>! Definitely a valuable tool and just in time for spec 0.11.0 release 😂 Yea I know, it's not that exciting for the beacon-spec, it passes all tests and is really just a set of BLS changes. Anyway, just updated ZRNT to v0.11.0 (other branch, not in master yet). No slow release again, haha. Will check the correctness of the test-vectors with ZRNT for you all, as more internals and tests were refactored/changed in v0.11.0. No big update spec-wise though, about 1-2 hours of going through beacon-spec diff. Hello folks! Cole from Staked.us here. If you’re interested in staking ETH, please free to send me a PM or submit your info below. https://staking.staked.us/ethereum-staking-options eth2 call in ~16 hours. Note that the time is stable wrt UTC. If you are in the US (and maybe other countries) you just went through a time adjustment so the call in an hour later than usual. agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/132 stream: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=orVYfqP_YuQ
